ruleset.name: joke
ruleset.description:
Every rule this artifact defines, as a single reference for consumers who want all of them.
This ruleset references only category/java/joke.xml. It deliberately pulls in none of PMD's stock categories and excludes nothing from them: a reference to a stock rule resolves against the consumer's PMD version, and a name PMD has since renamed or removed is a hard ruleset-load failure. Composing this with PMD's own categories is the consumer's business.
